_comment: Merge whichever of these this project doesn't already have into package.json. Version numbers are what the reference project pins — check for newer compatible versions if this is a fresh install.
notes: Drop @better-auth/expo if the client isn't Expo/React Native — also remove the expo() plugin and trustedOrigins' exp:// entries from lib/auth.ts.
Drop aws4fetch if the storage/image-upload package isn't being installed.
bun test is Bun's built-in test runner — no extra dependency needed.
